definitions.explanation: Temporary or part-time employment, often by students.

examples.japanese: {大学生|だいがくせい}の{時|とき}、アルバイトをしていた。
examples.english: I worked part-time when I was a college student.

examples.japanese: アルバイトを{探|さが}している。
examples.english: I'm looking for a part-time job.

notes: From German "Arbeit" (work). Often abbreviated to バイト.
